Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui.appearance

Record Class ControlAppearanceStyle

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.turboism.sdk.ui.appearance.ControlAppearanceStyle
Record Components:
foreground - optional Turboism-owned foreground color
background - optional Turboism-owned background color
font - optional bounded font override

Throws: NullPointerException if an optional is null

Throws: IllegalArgumentException if every property is absent

public record ControlAppearanceStyle(Optional<UiColor> foreground, Optional<UiColor> background, Optional<UiFont> font) extends Record
Bounded appearance properties for one control overlay.

At least one property is required. Absent properties retain the runtime-managed baseline rather than implying a host default or direct UI mutation.
